notes.title: Version 0.6.7 update
notes.content:
Hey breakers! We bring you a small update with a significant change in gameplay. After reviewing your videos and feedback, we noticed that the hacking process with the code was a bit slow, so we’ve updated it!
🎮 Gameplay
Proximity hacking: To hack a device, you now only need to bring your hand close. We believe this better matches the game’s frantic pace than having to enter a code.


Increased time warning: Now we alert you a little earlier so players have more margin to hurry up.


🎮 Other improvements and fixes
Audio volume and distance: Adjusted certain sounds so that they fade out more naturally and have a volume level appropriate to their importance.


Removed victory/defeat images: Previously, at the end of a level, an overlay image appeared saying “Victory” or “Defeat” (regardless of the language). We’ve removed this since the reason for victory or defeat is now explained via audio.


Adjusted warehouse doors: Fixed some doors that either wouldn’t open correctly or opened in the wrong direction.


[hr][/hr]


Ready to jump back into action? Let us know what you think about the changes!

notes.title: Version 0.6.3 Changelog
notes.content:
🛠️ Update 0.6.3 – Patch Notes
Thank you for continuing to play Codebreakers VR! This new update brings a ton of improvements designed to optimize the experience, expand accessibility, and make every mission even more intense. Here’s everything that’s new:



🎮 Gameplay & Experience



Power selection: From the base, you can now choose which powers to take into missions and assign them to the buttons you prefer.



Difficulty adjustment: Missions have been rebalanced for a fairer and more progressive challenge.



180° turn fade: Added a smooth fade effect for quick turns, improving comfort and reducing motion sickness.



Music preloading: Songs now load in parallel with the environment to prevent stutters at the start of a level.



Improved start in Warehouse: You now start inside an elevator when the level begins.





🌍 Accessibility & Languages



New languages available! (text only): German, Italian, French, Dutch, and Portuguese.





🔫 Graphics & Sound



Weapon effects: Muzzle flashes adjusted for more visual impact.



Improved collisions: Bullet impact effects now vary depending on the material (plants, metal, concrete, wood, pipes).



Visual feedback for power-ups: Added a visual effect when picking up a power-up.



Hacking machine sound feedback: Each pressed digit now plays a sound.



Song previews: From the base, you can listen to a preview of songs available for the level.



Shield impact sounds: New sound when bullets hit your shield.



Audio queue: Dialogues can now be queued to avoid overlapping.





🧭 Maps & Environment



Redesigned Warehouse: Layout and path changes with visual improvements.



Full retexturing: More immersive atmosphere with new textures.



Rescaled objects: More realistic proportions relative to the player.



Improved proximity detector: The hacking machine outline is now highlighted instead of showing an arrow.





📋 Menus & UI



Revamped pause menu: New black-and-white background clearly indicates the paused state.



Victory/defeat indicators: Generic ones removed. Now there are custom audio cues depending on the result.





🧠 Tutorial



Option to replay: Available from a new screen next to the shooting range.





⏱️ Time Indicators



Time remaining alerts:

At 30 seconds: vibration + red frame on the timer screen.

Last 5 seconds: 5 short vibrations on the left controller.





Ready to jump back into action? We’d love to hear your thoughts on these changes.

notes.title: Version 0.5.1 Changelog
notes.content:
In this first update, we focused on implementing improvements we noticed while watching gameplay videos on YouTube, as well as the great feedback many of you shared with us on the Steam forums. Thanks for playing and helping us improve! ❤️


HIGHLIGHTS

 Added support for the Russian language (voice-over only; text translation is still in progress).
 New mission added: "TRAINING", designed to help players get familiar with the core gameplay and main challenges.
 Slight increase in the grab distance range.


SURVIVABILITY

 Increased player health from 5 to 6 points.
 Slight reduction in the difficulty of the Warehouse map, and updated its difficulty tag.


USER INTERFACE

 UI improvements on the mission panel.
 New button added to the mission panel for direct access to our Discord community.
 New panel in the tutorial indicating that a weapon cannot be reloaded.
 New panel at the end of the tutorial showing where to find the hacking code.
 Light outline added to mission panel text for better readability.
 A confirmation prompt has been added to exit the game.


OTHER IMPROVEMENTS

 Improved tutorial flow, especially around firearm training and distance grab usage.
 If you were already inside a door’s trigger zone when it was unlocked, it didn’t open — now it will!
 Added some new interactive objects in the apartment.


BUG FIXES

 Fixed overlapping audio in some cases by adjusting playback timing.
 Level audio will no longer play if the player is already dead.
 Fixed an issue where some enemies weren’t marked when using the RX upgrade.
 Resolved a strange bug where you could win and lose the game at the same time (yep, really happened 😄).


And that's all for now!
We're committed to making CodebreakersVR an epic VR experience. A detailed roadmap is coming soon

—stay tuned!

notes.title: The Codebreakers Demo is Now Live! 🎉
notes.content:
Hello breakers!

We’re excited to announce that the demo for our first game is now available! 

This is your chance to dive in, explore its mechanics, and help shape the final experience with your feedback.

🎮 WHAT TO EXPECT

 A complete tutorial
 Customizable input settings
 Two game modes to explore:
🔹 KILL – Eliminate all enemies before time runs out.
🔹 INTEL – Hack the device to win. Stealth or combat? You decide.
 An apartment hub – A place to relax and plan your next mission.

More game modes will be added soon!


💬 WE WANT YOUR FEEDBACK!

Your thoughts are crucial in making Codebreakers the best it can be! Let us know what you think, report bugs, and share suggestions:

📢Steam discussion thread

📢Discord server
